subheader: The billing rules, as questions and answers
lead: The answers stay open, not folded away. Support teams link to them often, and the browser's search can find them.
note: The note says which rules apply to whom, and what overrides them.

rules.title: Each question is a heading
rules.bodytext: Each rule is a level-three heading, so the page has a clear outline.

rules.title: Each answer is rich text
rules.bodytext: Editors can add a paragraph, a list or a link without needing a new field for each case.

rules.title: The answers stay open
rules.bodytext: Find-in-page reaches them and printing keeps them. Readers who arrive from a support email see the answer straight away.
